description: Non material amendment to planning permission 24/1511/FUL - to alter wording of the CMP and CEMP conditions to allow for a phased construction process (i.e demolition and then construction).
decision_conditions:
Part (A) No demolition shall take place, until a detailed Construction Ecological Management Plan (or similar) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the approved plan. 
Part (B) No works following demolition shall take place, until a detailed Construction Ecological Management Plan (or similar) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the approved plan. 
Reason: To prevent harm to wildlife and protect existing biodiversity
